Synthetic NFS-e fixture adapted from the fictitious example in https://github.com/mendesalexandre/php-nfse-nacional/blob/main/tests/fixtures/nfse-autorizada.xml (MIT). All identifiers and signature contents used here are test-only values. Adaptations exercise historical v1.00 MEI status 107, SHA-256 signature structure, and description whitespace. This fixture is not a legally valid signed invoice and contains no real customer data or A1 certificate.
